name: 19 - DB - Add Disruption Cases and Waitlist

parameters.query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS appointment_disruption_cases (
    id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,

    exception_id BIGINT NOT NULL
        REFERENCES schedule_exceptions(id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE,

    appointment_id BIGINT NOT NULL
        REFERENCES appointments(id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE,

    status TEXT NOT NULL
        CHECK (
            status IN (
                'awaiting_reschedule_consent',
                'awaiting_waitlist_consent',
                'reschedule_selected',
                'rescheduled',
                'cancelled',
                'waitlisted',
                'declined',
                'closed'
            )
        ),

    proposed_slots JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::JSONB,

    selected_starts_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    selected_ends_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    patient_decision TEXT
        CHECK (
            patient_decision IS NULL
            OR patient_decision IN (
                'reschedule',
                'cancel',
                'waitlist',
                'decline'
            )
        ),

    decision_note TEXT,

    contacted_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    responded_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    resolved_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),

    UNIQUE (exception_id, appointment_id)
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_disruption_cases_status
    ON appointment_disruption_cases(status, created_at);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_disruption_cases_appointment
    ON appointment_disruption_cases(appointment_id, created_at DESC);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS appointment_waitlist (
    id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,

    clinic_id BIGINT NOT NULL
        REFERENCES clinics(id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE,

    doctor_id BIGINT NOT NULL
        REFERENCES doctors(id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE,

    patient_id BIGINT NOT NULL
        REFERENCES patients(id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE,

    service_id BIGINT
        REFERENCES services(id)
        ON DELETE SET NULL,

    original_appointment_id BIGINT
        REFERENCES appointments(id)
        ON DELETE SET NULL,

    disruption_case_id BIGINT
        REFERENCES appointment_disruption_cases(id)
        ON DELETE SET NULL,

    desired_from TIMESTAMPTZ,
    desired_to TIMESTAMPTZ,

    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active'
        CHECK (
            status IN (
                'active',
                'offered',
                'booked',
                'cancelled',
                'expired'
            )
        ),

    priority INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 100,
    consent_given_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,

    notes TEXT,
    source TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'assistant',

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),

    CHECK (
        desired_to IS NULL
        OR desired_from IS NULL
        OR desired_to > desired_from
    )
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_waitlist_active_search
    ON appointment_waitlist(
        doctor_id,
        service_id,
        priority,
        created_at
    )
    WHERE status = 'active';

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uq_active_waitlist_disruption_case
    ON appointment_waitlist(disruption_case_id)
    WHERE status = 'active'
      AND disruption_case_id IS NOT NULL;

SELECT
    TRUE AS success,
    'migration_completed' AS result,
    'ساختار پرونده‌های تغییر فوری و لیست انتظار با موفقیت ایجاد شد.' AS message;

parameters.content:
## فقط یک‌بار اجرا شود

این Workflow دو ساختار ایجاد می‌کند:

1. `appointment_disruption_cases` برای مدیریت نوبت‌های تحت‌تأثیر تغییر برنامه پزشک
2. `appointment_waitlist` برای بیمارانی که با رضایت خود وارد لیست انتظار می‌شوند

پس از اجرای موفق، Workflow را غیرفعال نگه دار.
